$comment: VOIID design tokens — PEACOCK. Single source; mirrored by apps/ios DesignSystem/Theme.swift and apps/android ui/theme/Color.kt. Every colour is a {light,dark} pair: the app supports both themes plus a Light/Dark/System override, so a single-valued token can no longer describe the design. Contrast ratios are measured against the ground each token sits on; UI surfaces target 3:1 and text 4.5:1 (WCAG AA).

color.$comment: SPINE — peacock teal carries every primary action; it lifts in dark because one fixed accent always fails one of the two grounds.

background.$comment: warm off-white / near-black with a violet cast (flat charcoal reads dead on OLED)

sent.$comment: filled teal, 5.53:1 vs the light ground. Replaces #C8C8C8 on #DFDFDF, which measured 1.26:1 and was invisible on a mid-tier LCD in daylight.

textOnSent.$comment: 5.65:1 on the bubble in both themes

divider.$comment: must RECEDE — previously identical to accent, so nothing in the UI had hierarchy

accent.$comment: SPARK — the one warm counterweight (unread badges, live dots, missed calls). Used sparingly; its power is its rarity. THEME-SPLIT because the bright value measured only 2.49:1 on the light ground and failed white text at 2.70:1; the deeper light value gives 4.33:1 surface and 4.70:1 for white text.

domain.$comment: Section identity ONLY — icons, empty states, headers. Never bubbles or body text. Rotations of one lightness and chroma, which is what makes five hues read as one family.

status.$comment: Semantic, deliberately separate from the accent. State must NEVER be carried by hue alone — roughly 1 in 12 men has a colour-vision deficiency, so a missed call is red AND carries its icon and label.

typography.$comment: SF Pro Rounded (iOS) / equivalent rounded face (Android). Sizes in pt.
